Structural Changes (Numbering)

Models are iterative and build upon the prior version (except for 2 & 3)

  • m23.0: 2023 assessment model carried forward.
  • m25.0: 2025 bridge model (RTMB) with updated data time-series through 2026.
  • m25.1: Updated likelihoods for catch and survey biomass, priors & comps.
  • m25.2: 2nd fishery selectivity timeblock dome-shaped (Gamma).
Input Changes (Letters)
Suffix Definition
Base Original model structure (e.g., m25.0)
a Uses surveyISS input sample sizes for survey age comps (e.g., m25.0a)
b Change to model-based survey biomass
c Combines a & b
r Denotes the model has used Francis re-weighting

Model Key: .0= Base | .1= Likelihoods | .2= Gamma Slx  |  .a= Survey ISS | .b= Model-based Srv | .c= .a + .b | .r= Francis Reweighted
